host.note: Evidence is host- and protocol-bound; do not generalize to other devices.

statusLegend.diagnostic-pass: The exact model/data/backend combination completed and satisfied the report's execution/parity contract.
statusLegend.controlled-diagnostic: Strategy or degradation behavior was exercised, but the data or labels cannot close a quality gate.
statusLegend.partial: Execution completed with documented backend, granularity, or output differences.
statusLegend.incomplete: Required legal, attributable, or cross-backend evidence is not available.

evidence.area: PP-OCR v4/v5/v6 core seven-model complete-page smoke
evidence.result: 14 model/backend combinations completed 10/10 pages; see per-model reports and summary.
evidence.boundary: Word-level SROIE boxes versus text-line polygons; smoke diagnostics only; no CUDA/TensorRT/OpenCV/PP-Structure claim.

evidence.dataset: HierText validation sample-002/sample-003, 1,557 eligible source-linked text-line crops
evidence.boundary: Recognizer-only bounded local evidence; does not close complete-page recall, long text, robustness, or other backends.

evidence.result: All backends completed 34/34 pages; ORT/OpenVINO page text sequences match 34/34; OpenCV matches ORT 11/34 pages and differs on 178/1,368 aligned regions.
evidence.boundary: OpenCV importer/text behavior remains backend-specific; one-shot latency is not a formal performance ranking.

evidence.result: 40/40 pages and 1,978 regions per comparison; ordered text has zero indexed mismatches.
evidence.boundary: FUNSD word-level annotations do not match text-line output granularity; metrics are diagnostic only.

evidence.result: 40/40 pages; 2,357 regions; ordered text matches 39/40 pages with one indexed difference.
evidence.boundary: Not strict backend parity, official accuracy, or release quality.

evidence.result: All 3 backends completed 10/10 pages; 531 regions and ordered page text match. One-shot P50/P95 observations are ORT 1302.87/2534.95 ms, OpenVINO 779.76/1054.15 ms, OpenCV 7722.31/10131.55 ms.
evidence.boundary: One model, one selection, one measured iteration; no general backend or 5/50 performance claim.

evidence.dataset: 4 real SROIE pages, 32 parent-linked crops with controlled known-angle transforms
evidence.result: 32/32 retries executed; 16/16 right-angle comparable rows selected the expected direction; text and direction outputs agree across backends.
evidence.boundary: Not natural rotation accuracy; confidence threshold 1 and zero gain are diagnostic settings, not production defaults.

evidence.dataset: Controlled SROIE/FUNSD parent-linked crops and pages
evidence.result: Execution and decisions agree across backends; candidate enhancement can improve and worsen CER, and 5-fold safe-threshold calibration abstained on all folds.
evidence.boundary: No natural low-quality split, business-field false-correction gate, or formal cost budget; default enhancement remains opt-in.

evidence.area: A2 data-availability audit across the local OCR benchmark inventory
evidence.result: 32,694 eligible annotation lines; maximum natural line 132 characters; maximum page aggregate 2,348 characters; natural continuous lines >=3,200: 0.
evidence.boundary: Inventory only; no OCR execution or accuracy result. Page aggregates, concatenated crops and synthetic compositions cannot close A2.

openGates.reason: Need output-granularity-matched labels and explicit acceptance thresholds.
No legal attributable natural continuous line >= 3200 characters; current HierText maximum is about 132 characters.
No valid natural angle/upright-inverted OCR label intersection; controlled retry is not a natural accuracy result.
Controlled degradation exists, but independent natural split, business-field false-correction gate, and formal cost budget are missing.
Quality reports use one-shot observations; unified 5-warm-up/50-measured and telemetry protocol remains separate.
Backend evidence is model/runtime-specific; formula, SLANeXt, Chart2Table and other PP-Structure boundaries remain open.

reproduction.note: External datasets, labels and raw predictions are not committed; follow each linked report for exact manifests and commands.
